To : All students
From: Mark Smith
Date: May 31
Subject: Course Selection Form Submission Notice
Dear students,
The deadline for submitting your course selection forms has been extended to Friday, March 15th. This gives you three extra days to discuss options with your teachers or parents. Please submit your completed forms to the main office before 4 PM on the new deadline day. Late submissions cannot be accepted.
Warm regards,
Mark Smith

Where should forms be submitted? 原文依据：Please submit your completed forms to the main office before 4 PM on the new deadline day. 表格需要交到校长办公室 / 总办公室。 A：校长办公室 → 正确 B：图书馆 → 错误 C：教师信箱 → 错误 D：在线平台 → 错误
